**What it is for:**  
A remediation planner for nursing students—generates balanced 7-day study schedules from a JSON file of missed exam questions (topic tags + notes), distributing topics so no day has more than two from the same client need. Creates a journal to track study completion and progress.

**Rules to follow:**  
- Standard library only, no external dependencies or network access
- Plain JSON files for storage (text-editor editable on mobile)
- Never include actual question text from paid qbanks (UWorld, Archer, Kaplan)—topic tags and notes only
- All study tasks must stay within PN scope: reinforce, monitor, report, follow care plans (no independent assessment, diagnosis, treatment, or prescribing)
- 7 days is the default length
- Keep it local and private; no packaging, GitHub, or public sharing
- Balance is enforced (tests verify it)
- No gamification/streaks/leaderboards
